text:
Ravi: Need final benchmark narrative for Wed webinar — focus: latency vs cost + concrete routing. quick ideas?
Sasha: 3-panel visual: cost per 1k, latency curves (median/p95), routing map (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). clean icons.
Eli: Data anchor: sample N=5k requests; median prompt=320, p95=3.2k. bench-bot will post numbers. note: Dedicated steadier but sometimes higher median.
Jordan: Social soundbite options: "Make inference predictable: lower unit costs, honest latency SLAs." or "Pay for predictability, not surprises."
Priya: Form questions to route leads: priority (cost|latency|compliance), monthly tokens, private deploy? map to tags.
Ravi: Add freeform: describe most latency-sensitive use case.
bench-bot: posted run 2156: Hosted median=85ms p95=345ms cost=$0.45/1k; Dedicated median=120ms p95=190ms cost=$0.28/1k; Quant median=95ms p95=210ms cost=$0.22/1k.
Eli: Footnote: batching uplift depends on length variance + KV cache hit rate. example: uniform short prompts -> 3.1x cost improvement; mixed lengths -> 1.2x.
Jordan: CTAs: "Get a tailored cost forecast" and "Request a latency POC" route to different flows.
Sasha: I'll deliver hero mock + panels by EOD. colors: high contrast for latency curves, muted for cost bars.
Priya: Sales playbook bullets by Mon midday. routing pseudocode ready.
Ravi: I'll draft landing copy now and post in ~90m. timeline OK?
All: ack, thanks.
